content: xterm.js @xterm/addon-serialize (repo typings verified): serialize() converts terminal rows+cursor+modes back into escape-sequence text that can be written back to recreate state; options scrollback N rows / range / excludeModes / excludeAltBuffer; serializeAsHTML for clipboard; @xterm/headless exists for Node - a server-side process can track terminal state headlessly and restore on reconnection (VS Code terminal revive uses this approach); xterm.js default scrollback 1000 lines; IBuffer API exposes viewport/baseY/cursor. Architectural option: server-side raw ring replay (simple, approximate) vs server-side headless VT state (precise, heavy) - serialize addon makes the latter feasible without writing a VT parser.
